title: Tool handoff negli adapter + deprecation file-based
summary: handoff_list/show/write/clear in pi-adapter e plan-mcp; deprecare .planner/HANDOFF.md (redirect plan_write_handoff → scrivi su fase corrente).
description:
Esporre i tool handoff per-entity in entrambi gli adapter (pi-adapter, plan-mcp) e deprecare il path file-based.

## Stato attuale (codice)
- pi-adapter: `buildHandoffMarkdown` (index.ts:366), tool `plan_write_handoff` (:572), hygiene gate (:899/2024/2060), comandi show/prepare (:2145-2170) — tutti su `.planner/HANDOFF.md`.
- plan-mcp: `planner-handoff-show/write/prepare/clear` (index.ts:795-817) + hygiene notice (:719) — file-based.
- Risoluzione entità: esiste già `findTaskByRef`/risoluzione fase per ID composito (P00x) e short-form — riusarla.

## Work items
1. **pi-adapter**: aggiungere tool `handoff_list` (→ `st.listHandoffs()`), `handoff_show <phaseRef>` (→ `getPhaseHandoff`), `handoff_write <phaseRef>` (→ `setPhaseHandoff`; default = fase in-progress corrente se omesso), `handoff_clear <phaseRef>`. Aggiornare superficie comandi `/planner handoff` + completions.
2. **plan-mcp**: aggiungere gli stessi 4 tool (`planner-handoff-list/show/write/clear`) usando le ops core di P2. Aggiornare tool list.
3. **Deprecation file-based**:
   - `plan_write_handoff` / `planner-handoff-write` → redirect a `handoff_write` sulla fase corrente (in-progress) con **warn di deprecation**.
   - `plan_get_handoff` / `planner-handoff-show` (file) → redirect a `handoff_list`/`handoff_show`.
   - `plan_delete_handoff` / `planner-handoff-clear` (file) → redirect a `handoff_clear` della fase corrente.
   - Rimuovere `buildHandoffMarkdown` path file (o tenerlo come helper per comporre il testo da scrivere sul campo fase).
4. Risoluzione `phaseRef`: accettare `P00x`, `P00x(F00x)`, UUID. Validare e restituire errore chiaro se non trovata.

## Rischi
- Backward compat: agent esistenti che chiamano `plan_write_handoff` devono ancora funzionare (redirect con warn).
- Collisioni nomi tool; consistenza superficie tra Pi e MCP.
- Risoluzione composite ref: gestione short-form `P00x` univoco.

## Comportamenti da preservare
- ID compositi in chat (mai UUID nudi).
- Core harness-agnostic (ops in @agent-plan/core).

tasks.description:
**P3 — tool handoff in pi-adapter.**

## Da fare in packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts
1. Registrare tool `handoff_list` (→ `st.listHandoffs()`), `handoff_show <phaseRef>` (→ `getPhaseHandoff`), `handoff_write <phaseRef> [text]` (→ `setPhaseHandoff`; se `phaseRef` omesso → fase in-progress corrente; text da arg o markdown_content), `handoff_clear <phaseRef>` (→ `clearPhaseHandoff`; default fase corrente).
2. Aggiornare superficie comandi `/planner handoff` (list|show|write|clear) + completions TAB.
3. Messaggi di conferma con **ID composito** (P00x(F00x)), mai UUID nudi.

## Edge case
- `handoff_write` senza text → errore "fornire il testo".
- fase corrente non in-progress → suggerire di specificare phaseRef.

---
**Completion summary:**
Done. Added 4 entity-scoped handoff tools + /planner surface to packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts. Imports: findPhaseByRef from @agent-plan/core, formatPhaseRef from @agent-plan/core/naming. Helper resolvePhaseForHandoff(st, ref): ref (P00x/P00x(F00x)/UUID/title) via core findPhaseByRef; omitted -> current in-progress phase (phase.status, or phase containing an in-progress task); returns {phase, compositeRef} or {error}. Tools (pi.registerTool): handoff_list (-> st.listHandoffs(), composite refs + firstLine + updatedAt), handoff_show (phaseRef?, -> getPhaseHandoff), handoff_write (phaseRef?, content/markdown_content -> setPhaseHandoff; errors on empty text), handoff_clear (phaseRef?, -> clearPhaseHandoff). All messages use composite IDs (P00x(F00x)), never raw UUIDs. /planner handoff command: added `list`; converted show/write/clear to entity-scoped with optional phaseRef (default in-progress); write prompts via ctx.ui.input; kept `prepare` (legacy file-based, T003 will deprecate). Updated completions (added handoff list, [P00x] labels), SUB_HELP, and the tool-list context block. Validation: pnpm -r build clean; pnpm check clean; smoke OK (default->in-progress P002(F001), P001/P002(F001) ref resolution, P999 not-found, write/show/list/clear ops path).

tasks.title: Deprecare handoff file-based (.planner/HANDOFF.md)
tasks.description:
**P3 — deprecation file-based.**

## Attuale
pi-adapter `plan_write_handoff`/`plan_get_handoff`/`plan_delete_handoff` + `buildHandoffMarkdown` (index.ts:366/572); plan-mcp `planner-handoff-show/write/prepare/clear` (index.ts:795-817) — tutti su `.planner/HANDOFF.md`.

## Da fare
1. `plan_write_handoff`/`planner-handoff-write` → redirect a `handoff_write` sulla **fase corrente in-progress** con **warn di deprecation** ("HANDOFF.md è deprecato, uso handoff su fase").
2. `plan_get_handoff`/`planner-handoff-show` (file) → redirect a `handoff_list`/`handoff_show`.
3. `plan_delete_handoff`/`planner-handoff-clear` (file) → redirect a `handoff_clear` fase corrente.
4. `buildHandoffMarkdown`: tenerlo come helper per comporre il testo da scrivere sul campo `handoff` (riusabile), rimuovere il path file.
5. Rimuovere/smettere di scrivere `.planner/HANDOFF.md`.

## Edge case
- Agent esistenti che chiamano i vecchi nomi devono ancora funzionare (redirect con warn, non break).

---
**Completion summary:**
Done. Deprecated the file-based .planner/HANDOFF.md path in favor of the entity-scoped phase.handoff field. Split: T003 = tools/prepare/hygiene; session-event auto-writes + resume summary/protocol stay file-based for P004 (resume flow).\n\npi-adapter (packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts):\n- plan_get_handoff: now calls st.listHandoffs() and returns phase handoffs with a deprecation warn (prefer handoff_list/show).\n- plan_write_handoff: now composes markdown via buildHandoffMarkdown (kept as helper), resolves the current in-progress phase via resolvePhaseForHandoff, and st.setPhaseHandoff(phase.id, markdown) — writes to phase.handoff, not the file. Deprecation warn (prefer handoff_write).\n- plan_delete_handoff: now resolvePhaseForHandoff + st.clearPhaseHandoff. Deprecation warn (prefer handoff_clear).\n- Tool descriptions marked DEPRECATED.\n- /planner handoff prepare: instructions updated to use handoff_write on the current in-progress phase (entity-scoped); reminder → handoff_clear; notify text updated.\n- 2 hygiene notices (task-update in-progress, task-start): now check existsSync(HANDOFF.md) || listHandoffs().length>0 (covers the transition), message updated to /planner handoff list|show|clear.\n\nplan-mcp (packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts):\n- planner-handoff-prepare: instructions updated to entity-scoped (planner-handoff-write on in-progress phase; .planner/HANDOFF.md deprecated).\n- hygiene notice: now checks file OR listHandoffs().length>0; message updated to planner-handoff-list|show|clear.\n\nbuildHandoffMarkdown kept as a reusable text composer (used by plan_write_handoff redirect). writeProjectHandoff retained (still called by session-event auto-writes — P004 will redirect those).\n\nValidation: pnpm -r build clean; pnpm check clean. (Ops path validated in P2/T001/T002 smokes.)

tasks.title: Risoluzione phaseRef (P00x / P00x(F00x) / UUID) + test
tasks.description:
**P3 — risoluzione riferimento fase.**

## Da fare
1. Helper/convenzione per risolvere `phaseRef` in un phaseId: accettare `P00x` (shortId univoco), `P00x(F00x)` (composito), o UUID. Riusare `findTaskByRef`/risoluzione esistente se presente, o fattorizzarne una `findPhaseByRef`.
2. Validazione: restituire errore chiaro se non trovata o ambigua (più fasi con stesso shortId — non dovrebbe accadere se shortId univoci globali).
3. Test: risoluzione nelle 3 forme; non-trovato → errore.

## Edge case
- shortId `P00x` deve essere globalmente univoco (prerequisito: shortId generator global — già fatto in feature precedente).

---
**Completion summary:**
Done. Added harness-agnostic phase-ref resolution to @agent-plan/core. New packages/plan-core/src/refs.ts exports findPhaseByRef(phases, features, ref): Phase | undefined — resolves (case-insensitive): UUID (phase.id exact), short ref P00x / p1 (phase.number, globally unique per F004-P1), composite P00x(F00x) (validates parent featureId against the (F00x) feature number, returns undefined on mismatch), and title fallback (exact then includes) for backward compat with agents using titles. Empty/whitespace ref → undefined. Exported from barrel (index.ts: `export * from "./refs.js"`). Tests: packages/plan-core/test/phase-ref.test.mjs (8 node:test cases: short ref, lowercase/non-padded, composite with parent validation, wrong-parent→undefined, UUID case-insensitive, title fallback, non-existent→undefined, empty→undefined). Validation: 23/23 tests pass (7 storage + 8 handoff + 8 ref); pnpm -r build clean; pnpm check clean. Note: reverted an accidental .mjs→.ts test-conversion experiment (kept tests as .mjs, the existing convention). Ready for T001/T002 to consume findPhaseByRef.
